name: B-Stance Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, one foot flat and the other a half-step behind with only the toes lightly touching the floor.
Soften the front knee and push your hips straight back, sliding the dumbbells down along your front thigh.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your front foot through the floor and squeeze the glutes to stand tall.
Complete all reps, then switch the staggered foot.
cues: Most of the weight on the front foot
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A Romanian deadlift variation with a staggered stance that shifts most of the load onto the front leg while the back foot only stabilises.

commonMistakes: Putting too much weight on the back foot
Rounding the lower back at the bottom
Turning it into a squat by bending the knees too much
safetyNotes: Use a load you can control on one leg; stop if you feel pinching in the low back.
